cards.title: One mouth authority: the producer shapes it and closures shut on every surface
shared_surfaces: docs/adr/0120-athena-has-a-face.md (an appended 'Measured' section: the producer owns the mouth, closures carry a visibility floor; decision 3's 'speech opens the mouth' moves from the driver to the producer)
acceptance: face-timeline addVisemes, sample_rate 24000, segments [aa 0-2400][PP 2400-3360 (40 ms)][oh 3360-6000] -> the PP segment spans >= 60 ms (1440 samples), the time is borrowed from its neighbours, the sentence's start and end are unchanged and the segments still tile with no gap or overlap

addVisemes where the neighbours cannot spare the time ([kk 16 ms][PP 30 ms][DD 16 ms]) -> PP grows only as far as the neighbours keep >= one 60 Hz frame (16.7 ms) each, is never merged away, and the order of sounds is unchanged

one table: for every viseme v and levels 0.2, 0.5, 0.9, the producer's mouthTarget(v, level) equals the driver's speech target for a signal {viseme: v, level} (today the producer normalises by SPEECH_LEVEL 0.7 and the driver uses the raw level, so 'aa' at 0.5 is 0.99 vs 0.875) - and SHAPE_OPEN no longer exists beside VISEME_SHAPES

driver fed the mirrored 30 Hz stream of the calm line and stepped at 60 fps (Main's view) -> inside each of the 3 PP segments pose.open <= 0.05 for >= 2 consecutive frames (before: minima 0.08 / 0.10 / 0.31)
driver fed the producer's full 60 fps stream (her own window) and the 30 Hz mirror of the same line -> at every segment midpoint the two pose.open values differ by <= 0.05 (two surfaces, one mouth)

cards.body:
## Summary
Her mouth is computed twice by two rules: the producer in the athena window shapes `open` from one table with loudness normalised to 0.7, then every face's driver throws that away and re-derives the mouth from a copy of the table with the raw level and a 35 ms lag. The closures that make speech read as speech (the 40-50 ms PP and FF segments) never shut, worst on Main.

## Description
Make the producer the one mouth authority (talking-avatar `face-signal-across-surfaces`: one producer, every surface a mirror; `viseme-drive`: closures are never merged away and grow to a visibility floor by borrowing from neighbours). One viseme table (VISEME_SHAPES) serves both mouthTarget and the fixtures; SHAPE_OPEN goes. face-timeline grows each closure to >= 60 ms at addVisemes time, borrowing from neighbours so the sentence still tiles. The mirror sends a closure onset at once, like a phase change. The driver's speech layer follows `signal.open` with a short closing constant instead of re-deriving it, so her window and Main draw the same mouth.

## Flow
- daemon voice.visemes -> face-timeline (closure floor applied once)
- producer frame -> visemeAt -> mouthTarget (one table) -> smoothOpen -> signal.open
- mirror: phase change or closure onset at once, else <= 30 Hz
- driver: pose.open follows signal.open; procedural, neural and settle layers unchanged

## Expected impact
Every spoken line on every surface: bilabials visibly close, the breath between words no longer opens the mouth, and the companion window and Main stop showing two different mouths. A whole class (two authorities for one vocabulary drifting) closes.

## Evaluation
Claim: a PP closure reaches shut (<= 0.05) for >= 2 frames on Main and on her window.
Before: PP minimum opening over the calm fixture (n=3 PP, scratch replica of driver.ts formulas, 60 fps): her window 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.19, Main's 30 Hz mirror 0.08 / 0.10 / 0.31; 0 of 8 acceptance cases' new behaviour passes (case 8 green by design)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - the acceptance cases
Result: better
Gate: none

cards.body:
## Summary
The person chooses her face blind: the first act's Face step shows each form idling and Voice settings offers three words. The app already has a scripted speaking line with exact visemes. And when a face cannot draw, the slot where she stood goes empty instead of falling back to the Bell as ADR 0120 promises.

## Description
A small audition module plays the calm fixture through a FaceSource on the window's one clock, one form at a time, silent, still under Calm (motion `reduced-motion-mechanics`, `unprompted-motion-lifecycle`: it plays on focus/hover, never on its own). The Face step auditions the focused card; Voice settings gains one figure of the chosen form with a 'see her speak' press (still at most one face in Main, as settings draw no field figure). A cached canDrawFace() probe (adaptive-fidelity-tiers `measured-not-declared-capability`) lets both pickers grey out forms this computer cannot draw. <Avatar> takes a `fallback` and shows it when the runtime reports unavailable (one state change, never per frame), so Her() and the surface show the Bell (talking-avatar `face-signal-across-surfaces`: 'no face where it cannot draw').

## Flow
- focus a face card -> audition.play(form) -> card's Avatar speaks the sample line -> blur stops it
- no WebGL2 -> face cards disabled, halo kept, one plain line why
- runtime fail -> onUnavailable -> Avatar renders fallback (the Bell)

## Expected impact
The one appearance decision in the product is made seeing what it decides; nobody can pick a face that will render as an empty box, and a lost or unsupported face hands its slot back to the Bell everywhere.

## Evaluation
Claim: the pickers show each form speaking, refuse forms that cannot draw, and an unavailable face falls back.
Before: 0 of 9 acceptance cases pass for the new behaviour (case 8's warn-once half and case 9's halo half are green by design)
After: 9 of 9
Method: gate - the acceptance cases
Result: better
Gate: none

Avatar.test.tsx:47-70 asserts the unavailable box is empty with a hidden canvas.

rehomed: Main's face freezes 'speaking' if the athena window reloads or dies mid-line: the producer's stop (face-signal.ts:249) sends no rest signal, Main's hub replays the last one and the driver never settles (a frame loop forever) - a staleness watchdog in createMainFaceSource is S
Loudness normalised to a high percentile of the line (viseme-drive) instead of the fixed SPEECH_LEVEL 0.7 - S once card A has made the producer the only mouth authority
Unknown visemes read as 'sil' silently (face-timeline.ts:99); viseme-drive says a neutral mid vowel, counted - S
isFaceSignal checks finiteness but does not clamp level/open into range at the boundary (face.ts:34; face-signal-across-surfaces) - S
